title: 🔬 ANRF ₹1 Lakh Crore RDI Fund — Concessional Tech & Biotech Innovation Financing
attentionJustification: ₹1L Cr research fund with 2-4% interest and 15-yr tenure across TDB and BIRAC.

constituentArticles.title: ANRF launches ₹1 Lakh Crore RDI Fund first call under TDB
constituentArticles.text: Dr. Jitendra Singh launched 1st call of TDB under ₹1 Lakh Crore Research, Development & Innovation Fund of ANRF (2-4% interest, up to 15-yr tenure, TRL 4+).

constituentArticles.title: BIRAC-RDI Fund for Biotechnology launched by Dr. Jitendra Singh
constituentArticles.text: DBT's BIRAC appointed second-level manager to deploy ₹2,000 Cr under ₹1L Cr RDI framework.
